definitions.explanation: The red fluid circulating in the body.

examples.english: When I had a blood test at the hospital, I was told I was slightly anemic.

notes:
{血液|けつえき} is the medical/scientific term for blood. In everyday conversation, ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧ is used instead.

- ⟦{血液|けつえき}{検査|けんさ}→血液検査：23299_ketsuekikensa⟧: blood test

CULTURAL NOTE:
Blood type (⟦{血液|けつえき}{型|がた}→血液型：03053_ketsuekigata⟧) is a popular topic in Japan, where many people believe it influences personality. The four types (A, B, O, AB) are commonly discussed in social contexts.
